source_claims.quote: Often depicted in art wielding a scythe he was considered an agricultural god, especially associated with seed-corn.

statement.id: Saturn adalah dewa pertanian yang sering digambarkan membawa sabit.
statement.en: Saturn is an agricultural god often shown with a scythe.

source_claims.quote: Saturn himself, however, was represented as veiled (involutus), as for example in a wall painting from Pompeii that shows him holding a sickle and covered with a white veil.

statement.id: Saturnus sendiri digambarkan berkerudung (involutus), misalnya pada lukisan dinding dari Pompeii yang menunjukkannya memegang sabit dan berselubung kerudung putih.
statement.en: Saturn himself was represented as veiled (involutus), for example in a wall painting from Pompeii showing him holding a sickle and covered with a white veil.

source_claims.quote: Plac’d in their ranks, their godlike grandsires stood; Old Saturn, with his crooked scythe, on high; And Italus, that led the colony; And ancient Janus, with his double face,
source_claims.locator: Book VII, the palace of Picus

statement.id: Dalam penggambaran Virgil, para leluhur yang menyerupai dewa ditempatkan berbaris; di antara mereka Saturnus tua dengan sabit bengkoknya di tempat tinggi, Italus, dan Janus tua berwajah ganda.
statement.en: In Virgil's description, godlike ancestors are placed in ranks; among them old Saturn with his crooked scythe on high, Italus, and ancient Janus with his double face.

source_claims.quote: In Roman and Etruscan reckoning Saturn is a wielder of lightning; no other agricultural god (in the sense of specialized human activity) is one.

statement.id: Dalam perhitungan Romawi dan Etruria, Saturnus adalah pemegang petir; tidak ada dewa pertanian lain yang demikian.
statement.en: In Roman and Etruscan reckoning Saturn is a wielder of lightning; no other agricultural god is one.

source_claims.quote: According to Roman legend, Saturn settled in Latium on the future site of Rome.

statement.id: Legenda Romawi menempatkan Saturn di Latium.
statement.en: Roman legend places Saturn in Latium.

source_claims.quote: His temple, built around 498 BCE, was located at the foot of Capitoline Hill and housed the Roman treasury as well as the records and decrees of the Roman Senate.

statement.id: Kuil Saturn di kaki Bukit Capitoline menampung kas negara dan catatan Senat Romawi.
statement.en: Saturn's temple at the Capitoline Hill housed the Roman treasury and Senate records.
